children: Thailand's 2026 economic growth is likely to remain modest, despite a potentially stronger 3Q performance, Barclays economists say in a note. A recent Bank of Thailand report showed that the economy expanded in July from June, partly driven by government stimulus. The private consumption index rose 1.2% on month in July. However, Barclays notes that the rise in private consumption could be short-lived, as the government stimulus is set to conclude at the end of September. Barclays expects Thailand's economy to expand 2.2% in 2026, slower than the 2.4% expansion in 2025. (amanda.lee@wsj.com)
